title: Sr. Data Analyst - Power BI
description:
YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation. At YASH, we re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth - bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future. We are looking forward to hire Power BI Professionals in the following areas : Job description: Experience required: 5+ years Requirements : FPD - Financial Operational Reporting - Power BI Developer - Insurance Analytics 
 
 
 Job Summary 
 
 We are seeking a mid-level to senior Power BI Developer with strong dashboard UI/UX expertise to design and deliver high-impact, intuitive analytics experiences for business stakeholders within Client Financial Insurance Services (CFIS). This role sits within the BI, Data, and AI team and is responsible for end-to-end dashboard development - from business requirements and wireframing through semantic model alignment, DAX measures, Power Query transformations, and performance optimization. The developer will play a key role in maintaining and expanding our library of 18+ key dashboards and 100+ governed reports that drive financial, operational, and strategic decision-making across the insurance division. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 - End-to-End Dashboard Development: Own the full lifecycle of Power BI report and dashboard development - requirements gathering, wireframe/mockup creation, data model alignment, DAX measure authoring, Power Query transformations, visual design, user acceptance testing, and production deployment. Ensure every deliverable is accurate, fast, and easy to consume. 
 - Financial Operational Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards that support key insurance business functions including policy administration, claims analysis, premium reporting, loss ratios, dealer solutions metrics, pricing analytics, and operational KPIs. Understand the business context behind the data and translate it into actionable, self-explanatory visualizations. 
 - Semantic Model Certified Data Source Alignment: Work closely with data modelers and the ETL team to consume governed, business-friendly semantic views published from Snowflake. Ensure Power BI semantic models (formerly datasets) are properly aligned with certified definitions - consistent field naming, correct relationships, and optimized for DirectQuery or Import mode depending on the use case. 
 - UI/UX Design Visualization Best Practices: Apply a user-centered design mindset to produce accessible, consistent, and visually compelling dashboards that drive adoption. Follow established CFIS design standards for layout, color schemes, navigation (drill-through, drill-down, bookmarks, tabs), and accessibility. Create reusable templates and visual patterns that raise the quality bar across the entire report portfolio. 
 - Row-Level Security Governance: Implement and maintain row-level security (RLS) to enforce data access policies across reports. Support deployment governance practices including environment management (Dev Pre-Prod Prod), version control, change advisory board (CAB) review processes, and release notes documentation. 
 - Performance Tuning Optimization: Monitor and optimize report performance - identifying slow-loading visuals, inefficient DAX, bloated models, or excessive data volume - and implement best practices such as aggregations, query folding, incremental refresh, and model size reduction. 
 - Collaboration Knowledge Sharing: Work closely with onshore team leads, data modelers, ETL developers, business analysts, and project managers to align report deliverables with business priorities. Participate in CAB reviews,weekly release notes, maintain user guides, and support business user onboarding to Power BI. 
 
 
 
 Qualifications Required: 
 - 5+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or report development 
 - 3+ years hands-on experience with Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service (report authoring, publishing, workspace management, app distribution) 
 - Strong proficiency in DAX (calculated measures, time intelligence, complex aggregations) and Power Query / M (data transformations, query folding, parameterized queries) 
 - Experience designing and optimizing semantic models (relationships, star schemas, Import vs. DirectQuery mode selection) 
 - Demonstrated UI/UX design skills - ability to create intuitive, accessible, visually polished dashboards 
 - Experience implementing row-level security (RLS) and environment-based deployment governance (Dev/Test/Prod) 
 - Strong SQL proficiency for data validation, troubleshooting, and ad hoc analysis 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills; ability to work effectively in a distributed, global team 
 Preferred: 
 - Power BI Paginated Report Builder for our standard accounting and financial reporting 
 - Experience connecting Power BI to Snowflake (SSO, DirectQuery, Import) 
 - Familiarity with Snowflake semantic views or governed data layers as a consumption source 
 - Experience with Streamlit or other lightweight data application frameworks 
 - Exposure to self-service analytics platforms or natural language query tools (e.g., Polaris AI / Snowflake Intelligence) 
 - Insurance, financial services, or regulated industry domain experience 
 - Experience with Power BI REST APIs, deployment pipelines, or CI/CD for BI assets 
 - Power BI certifications (PL-300 or equivalent) At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale. Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity Agile self-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration All Support needed for the realization of business goals, Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture
